thread:
Nina Gomez: dropping a compact set of copy variants for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing rows. Need sign-off for launch posts + webinar gating. Quick ask: keep Hosted super self-serve, Dedicated clearly explains committed capacity, Private emphasizes compliance and on-prem options. Drafts in the drive: https://drive.google.com/mock-landing-drafts
Ethan Ross: nice. Can we include one-sentence benchmark lines under each hero? e.g. Hosted: 'start in minutes — 50ms p95 on small models'; Dedicated: 'predictable p99 at scale'; Private: 'data stays inside your network, KMS enabled'.
Priya Singh: CTA proposals: Hosted -> "Create account & get API key"; Dedicated -> "Estimate capacity"; Private -> "Contact sales (private)". Also recommend the form fields differ per CTA so leads route to correct AE team.
Marco Diaz: routing sketch:
```
/path?deploy=hosted -> marketing-plg (auto-trial)
/path?deploy=dedicated -> sales-dedicated (ask: qps, model, commit)
/path?deploy=private -> sales-enterprise (tag: compliance, onprem)
/register/webinar -> nurture-webinar-llm-scale
```
Will wire to hub forms.
Ava Reynolds: agree on fielding. For Dedicated add a simple slider for 'expected peak rps' and a checkbox 'need burst capacity' so we can estimate sizing faster.
Nina Gomez: for benchmark copy we'll need Ben/infrastructure to confirm p95/p99 and cost per 1k tokens. Priya, can you and Marco align the form questions with SFDC queues and add lead scoring rules?
Priya Singh: can do. Thinking: map "deploy=private" + "onprem=yes" -> enterprise-compliance queue; if budget > $50k -> AE-priority. Will document mapping.
Ethan Ross: social hooks: Day 0 hero + 3 benchmark highlights, Day 1 customer case snippet (internal test app), Day 3 webinar invite. Need short copy variants for social (X / LinkedIn) to test.
Marco Diaz: Webinar gating idea: add a compliance checkbox and a question "Do you need on-prem or air-gapped?" If yes, auto-assign to solutions engineer for pre-webinar outreach.
Ava Reynolds: microcopy tweak: avoid 'Private' alone. Use 'Private deployment (VPC / on-prem)' across pages so users understand it's not just a product label. Also clarify "Dedicated" as reserved GPU pools in a single line.
Nina Gomez: ok. Action list: 
- Ethan: 3 social hooks + benchmark snippets (due Mon)
- Marco: form-to-SFDC mapping doc + implementation notes (due Tue)
- Priya: CTA microcopy and field list + lead scoring (due Tue)
- Ben/infra (tagged offline): validate p95/p99 and cost metrics (due Mon)
- Marketing ops: implement routing rules in Hub Forms (due Wed)
Ethan Ross: I'll draft short social test variants and add image suggestions (benchmark chart + screenshot).
Priya Singh: I'll include sample copy for the Dedicated 'Estimate capacity' modal (2 options: quick estimate, deep sizing).
Marco Diaz: I'll drop the SFDC mapping in docs and ping ops for fields.
Nina Gomez: Perfect. Scheduling a 20m async review Fri AM. If anyone hits blockers ping me or drop notes in this thread. Thanks!
